paragraphs: Chapter 805
Episode 199. The Majesty of the Plutonian Tribe’s 13th Battle King (2)
'To fend off the bombardment of the red fleet... so easily.'
Facing the blue meteor shower battering the fleet, Rakiman had no choice but to shudder. He thought that as soon as the fleet was summoned, he would immediately seize the advantage.
That was not the case at all.
As soon as the bombardment began, Jin began to rampage even more fiercely, radiating energy. There was no sign of confusion or spirit wilting.
Those who had fallen, and the crew of the fleet, were doubting their eyes.
'Is Rakiman looking like he's lost, and we can't even strike him with our fleet?'
'We were warned by our Warlord brothers who had been on ground missions, but isn't this too different from the humans we remember...!'

While all the enemy tribes on the battlefield were in shock, only one person, the fleet commander, Shimat, seemed to anticipate this outcome and calmly observed the situation. Jin's meteor shower was already pushing back the bombardment and engulfing the battlefield.

Moreover, even in the terrible explosions that twisted space, Jin was constantly moving without rest. He deflected the falling bombardment with his sword, dodged fragments flying from all directions, and was advancing, finding Rakiman even without sight.
Rakiman couldn't move fast because he was looking after the fallen tribesmen.

'What my tribesmen should have done when Jin Runcandel suddenly appeared... was to use a return spell while Rakiman was buying time. If I had been at the operational site from the start, I would have advised Rakiman not to summon the fleet...!'
The summoning of the fleet is the highest and last resort the enemy tribes currently have.

This is because the revival of the enemy tribes is still in its very early stages. The awakened enemy tribes totaled no more than a few hundred, and only about 30% of them had fully regained their strength.
Therefore, there was a serious shortage of crew members to operate the red fleet under Rakiman, not to mention the fleet itself, Rakiman was also unable to exert his original power.
"Tribesmen, pull yourselves together! We have to save Rakiman. Change the target of the bombardment! Shift from the assassination of Jin Runcandel to the rescue of Rakiman!"
Shimat's voice spread throughout the entire fleet.
"But, brother Shimat! There has not been any change of orders from Rakiman yet. Changing the order as you wish is."
"Usurping? Look down there! Is Rakiman in a situation where he can give orders now? If Rakiman falls like this, we won't be able to awaken the other Warlord tribesmen."
The command system between the ranks of the enemy tribes is absolute.
Right now, Shimat was breaking that absolute discipline. The rest of the princes and warriors showed hesitation for a moment.

"I will take all responsibility. Flagship Lavieth, commence descent. I will personally go down to rescue Prince Rakiman. All the princes on board each fleet gather at Lavieth! The rest of the fleet will protect Prince Rakiman and the flagship, and when the signal is given, gather all power to Lavieth."

In the end, the Yuckmyung decided to follow Shimat's words. The flagship of the Yuckmyung 4th Fleet, Lavieth, exited the warp gate while forming a red protective shield. The princes teleported from their ships to Lavieth.

'The only ship that seems to be the flagship is coming out of the warp gate. Even the bombardment has changed to a flow that hinders progress rather than hitting me directly. Are they trying to rescue Rakiman?'
The ships, except for Lavieth, continued firing from inside the warp gate.
'I can't leave it like that.'
A blue glow formed in Jin's pupils. Although he didn't open the next chapter of Tusin Wu, he further ignited his anger.
Pijit! Zzzz...!

Lavieth, which had lowered its altitude, had its protective shield in contact with the area of the Myungwang gunrim sword. Thanks to the amplified chi of all the remaining princes, Lavieth was slowly able to invade the interior of the Myungwang gunrim sword.
'Surely, it seems to perform much better than the human ships. Even if all the lights aren't on, indicating that they can't use all their power, they're able to break through this chi.'
Since meeting the Yuckmyung, Jin had been admiring their technology.
He was even tempted. If he could properly analyze their technology, it wouldn't be such a difficult task to realize the 'Golden Fleet' blueprints given by Boras.
'Shall we see if we can withstand this?'
Destroyer Sword, Meteor Breaker.

This time, Hairan's secret technique fired a dark sword energy from the ground towards the ship. The Meteor Breaker, reinforced by the chi of the Myungwang Gunlim Sword, had a power that was no less than the original used by Ron Hairan in the past.

Cracks immediately appeared in the massive shield surrounding the warp gate. The red fleet scattered to narrowly avoid the incoming Meteor Breaker, tearing through the shield. One by one, ships seemed to lose their center, as if they were caught on reefs.
Looking at the sight, Shimat sighed in relief.
'It seems that Jin Runcandel has decided to attack the fleet, not the flagship. Fortunately, with that level of power, the flagship should be able to withstand it until Rakiman is secured.'
Following Myungwang Gunlim Sword, Meteor Rain and Meteor Breaker.
Jin had already sequentially displayed three transcendental swords. Shimat thought that no matter how powerful Jin was, it would be impossible to draw more power.
He realized that thought was a mistake only three seconds later.
'Why is he suddenly sticking the sword into the ground? Could it be... Ah! He still has this much power left...!'
Runcandel's First Decisive Battle, Crushing.
A gigantic sword energy dividing the ground and the sky poured out from the sword stuck in the ground. The target of that sword energy was the flagship Lafayette.
"Maximize the shield! Detonate the power concentration signal!"

At Shimat's urgent voice, Lafayette and the entire fleet began to resonate, glowing red. Jin didn't know about the technology of the Yekmin tribe, but he noticed that the energy of the fleet was momentarily focused on Lafayette.
'I must admit they have impressive technology, even if I don't know what it is.'
The sword energy of Crushing was hitting the bottom of Lafayette. The shield didn't tear, but the altitude increased due to the shock, and the distance between Lafayette and Rakiman increased.

Jin couldn't help but admire Lafayette's sturdy shield. Among the ships in existence in humanity, there is none that could withstand the Ming Wang Warlord Sword and Crushing without the help of a superhuman.
However, as Lafayette's shield became stronger, the intensity of the shelling noticeably decreased. Therefore, Jin could proceed towards Rakiman more smoothly than before.
Jin and Lafayette.
The key point was who would reach Rakiman first. Jin charged forward without even dodging the thin shelling, and Lafayette also increased its descending speed.

Naturally, the closer Lafayette got to the center of the Ming Wang Warlord Sword, the more energy it had to endure. Every time Lafayette got closer to Rakiman, crazily spreading cracks could be seen on Lafayette's shield.
"Rakiman! You were so confident summoning the fleet, are you going to keep hiding?"
For a really long time.

Rakiman admitted he was completely overwhelmed. Just like when he faced the god of war of the Yekmin and Chongmyung tribes in the past, or like when he faced the first great war king who always overpowered him. It felt as if insurmountable walls were blocking him from all sides.
Due to his uniquely calm nature, he was not gripped by fear, but he felt that he never wanted to face Jin again.
'I have to avoid fighting Jin Runcandel until all my brethren wake up. If I can survive today... and return.'
Because survival is a priority if he wants to fight again someday, Rakiman ignored Jin's provocation and wandered in search of a safer area. He struggled somehow to reach Lafayette.
'Rakiman brother! Hold on a little longer. We can rescue you...!'
Crack, creak!
Slowly, Lafayette's defense was reaching its limit. Fragments fell as parts of the hull broke, and inside, it was full of heat, causing many average warriors to collapse.
Shimat continued to transmit energy to the power source, his eyes wide open with veins bulging. His entire body was trembling, and it felt like his organs were all melting.
"Argh! Open the hatch...!"
Finally, Shimat's efforts bore fruit. Rakiman came within a reachable distance.
The hatch was opened only for a moment.

However, the aura of the Exalted Blade of the Ming King, which had entered the ship with the War Kings, including Rakiman, was slaughtering the crew. The Red Sage tribes below the 3rd rank War King, already exhausted from supplying power to the ship, couldn't withstand it and drew their last breaths.
Once aboard, Rakiman was panting, vomiting blood continuously. Andolin and the War Kings were unconscious, sporadically experiencing convulsions.
In Rakiman's pocket was the energy heart of the tribesman who just died on the ground. It had to be kept this way as there was no time to open the storage space again.
"Return! Raise the altitude!"
The Laviate began to ascend towards the dimension gate. The ship, which had been fine just a few seconds ago, was now barely speeding up, half torn apart.
Thanks to Rakiman, who just boarded and wrung out more energy from the energy heart, they managed to recover the shield.
The attacks that had been relentlessly battering the hull also stopped for a moment, but this brought no relief.
Rather, the anxiety was quickly amplified. After all, Jin wouldn't have stopped attacking because he was tired.
"Rakiman! You must adjust the dimension gate to close as soon as we enter!"
As the Red Sage tribe expected, Jin was preparing his last magic sword to strike at the fleeing tribes.
The Runcandel magic sword technique, Upha.

Sarah's magic sword, mixed with the aura of the Exalted Blade of the Ming King, swallowed the battlefield in an instant. Tess, summoned without anyone noticing, was gathering the flames of Upha towards one place. Towards Laviate, the Red Sage's flagship.
The blue flames chased after Laviate, which had risen to near the dimension gate in the blink of an eye.
Only then did Jin stop his sword and look up at the sky. Below the narrowing dimension gate, he saw the sight of Upha and Laviate chasing and being chased.
"Darn it, the flames of Jin Runcandel have entered the dimension gate with us...!"
The dimension gate closed.
Upha narrowly disappeared into the dimension gate along with Laviate, and Jin was left with one question.
"I missed it. But what happens when the flames of Upha enter the dimension gate with their flagship?"
Although Jin couldn't observe the result directly, the Red Sage tribes had to make many sacrifices for a while to block the flames of Upha even after they had fled beyond the dimension gate.
If they hadn't managed to escape through the dimension gate.
The resurrection of the Red Sage tribes would have ended today.
